symbols.name: negation
symbols.description: Negates a proposition: ¬p is true exactly when p is false.
symbols.description_zh: 命题的否定：¬p 为真当且仅当 p 为假。

symbols.name: conjunction
symbols.description: p ∧ q is true exactly when both p and q are true.
symbols.description_zh: p ∧ q 当且仅当 p、q 同时为真时为真。

symbols.name: disjunction
symbols.description: p ∨ q is true when at least one of p, q is true.
symbols.description_zh: p ∨ q 当 p、q 至少一个为真时为真。

symbols.name: material implication
symbols.description: p → q is false only in the case where p is true and q is false.
symbols.description_zh: p → q 仅在 p 真而 q 假时为假。

symbols.name: biconditional
symbols.description: p ↔ q abbreviates (p → q) ∧ (q → p); the two propositions have equal truth values.
symbols.description_zh: p ↔ q 是 (p → q) ∧ (q → p) 的缩写，表示两命题真值相同。

symbols.name: universal quantifier
symbols.description: ∀x, P(x) asserts that P holds for every element of the domain.
symbols.description_zh: ∀x, P(x) 表示论域中每个元素都满足 P。

symbols.name: existential quantifier
symbols.description: ∃x, P(x) asserts that at least one element satisfies P.
symbols.description_zh: ∃x, P(x) 表示至少存在一个元素满足 P。

symbols.name: unique existence
symbols.description: There is exactly one x with P(x).
symbols.description_zh: 恰好存在一个 x 使 P(x) 成立。

symbols.name: syntactic turnstile
symbols.description: Γ ⊢ φ means φ is derivable from the assumptions Γ by the rules of the proof system.
symbols.description_zh: Γ ⊢ φ 表示 φ 可由假设集 Γ 按证明系统规则推出。

symbols.name: semantic entailment
symbols.description: Every model that satisfies all of Γ also satisfies φ.
symbols.description_zh: 所有满足 Γ 中全部公式的模型都满足 φ。

symbols.name: truth constant (tautology)
symbols.description: The always-true proposition; unit of conjunction.
symbols.description_zh: 恒真命题，是合取的单位元。

symbols.name: falsity constant (contradiction)
symbols.description: The always-false proposition; unit of disjunction.
symbols.description_zh: 恒假命题，是析取的单位元。

symbols.name: necessity operator
symbols.description: In modal logic □p holds at a world when p holds at every accessible world.
symbols.description_zh: 模态逻辑中 □p 在世界 w 为真当且仅当 p 在所有可达世界为真。

symbols.name: possibility operator
symbols.description: Dual of necessity: ◇p ≡ ¬□¬p; p holds at some accessible world.
symbols.description_zh: 必然算子的对偶：◇p ≡ ¬□¬p，表示存在可达世界使 p 为真。

symbols.name: lambda abstraction
symbols.description: Anonymous function binding x in the term t.
symbols.description_zh: 匿名函数，在项 t 中绑定变量 x。

symbols.name: dependent function (Pi) type
symbols.description: Generalizes A → B so that the codomain may depend on the input.
symbols.description_zh: 推广函数类型 A → B，使陪域可依赖于输入。

symbols.name: dependent pair (Sigma) type
symbols.description: Elements are pairs (a, b) with a : A and b : B(a).
symbols.description_zh: 元素为对 (a, b)，其中 a : A、b : B(a)。

symbols.name: definite description
symbols.description: The unique x satisfying P(x), when it exists (Hilbert's iota operator).
symbols.description_zh: 满足 P(x) 的唯一 x（希尔伯特 iota 算子）。

symbols.name: NAND (Sheffer stroke)
symbols.description: p ↑ q ≡ ¬(p ∧ q); NAND alone is functionally complete.
symbols.description_zh: p ↑ q ≡ ¬(p ∧ q)；仅用与非即可表达所有真值函数。

symbols.name: NOR (Peirce arrow)
symbols.description: p ↓ q ≡ ¬(p ∨ q); NOR alone is functionally complete.
symbols.description_zh: p ↓ q ≡ ¬(p ∨ q)；仅用或非即可表达所有真值函数。

symbols.name: exclusive or
symbols.description: True when exactly one of p and q is true.
symbols.description_zh: 当 p、q 恰有一个为真时为真。

symbols.name: substitution instance
symbols.description: φ[t/x] replaces every free occurrence of x in φ by the term t, avoiding variable capture.
symbols.description_zh: 把 φ 中 x 的所有自由出现替换为项 t，并避免变量捕获。

symbols.name: sequent arrow
symbols.description: Meta-level arrow separating the antecedent Γ from the succedent Δ in a sequent.
symbols.description_zh: 在相继式中分隔前件 Γ 与后件 Δ 的元语言箭头。

symbols.name: therefore sign
symbols.description: Marks an inferred conclusion in an informal proof.
symbols.description_zh: 在非形式证明中标记推出的结论。

symbols.name: because sign
symbols.description: Marks a reason or premise in an informal proof.
symbols.description_zh: 在非形式证明中标记理由或前提。

symbols.name: discharged assumption label
symbols.description: In natural deduction, brackets mark an assumption that later inference rules discharge.
symbols.description_zh: 自然演绎中用方括号标记可被后续规则解除的假设。

symbols.name: end-of-proof marker
symbols.description: The QED / Halmos symbol closing a completed proof.
symbols.description_zh: 结束证明的 QED（哈尔莫斯）符号。

symbols.name: set of free variables
symbols.description: The variables occurring in φ that are not bound by a quantifier.
symbols.description_zh: 公式 φ 中未被量词约束的变元集合。

symbols.name: definitional equality
symbols.description: In type theory t ≡ u means t and u are definitionally equal: they reduce to a common form.
symbols.description_zh: 类型论中 t ≡ u 表示 t 与 u 定义相等：二者归约到同一形式。

symbols.name: empty set
symbols.description: The unique set with no elements: ∀x, x ∉ ∅.
symbols.description_zh: 不含任何元素的集合：∀x, x ∉ ∅。

symbols.name: element membership
symbols.description: a ∈ A means a is an element of the set A.
symbols.description_zh: a ∈ A 表示 a 是集合 A 的元素。

symbols.name: non-membership
symbols.description: a ∉ A means a is not an element of A.
symbols.description_zh: a ∉ A 表示 a 不是集合 A 的元素。

symbols.name: subset
symbols.description: A ⊆ B means every element of A lies in B.
symbols.description_zh: A ⊆ B 表示 A 的每个元素都属于 B。

symbols.name: proper subset
symbols.description: A ⊂ B means A ⊆ B and A ≠ B.
symbols.description_zh: A ⊂ B 表示 A ⊆ B 且 A ≠ B。

symbols.name: union
symbols.description: Elements belonging to A or to B (or both).
symbols.description_zh: 属于 A 或属于 B（或二者）的元素构成的集合。

symbols.name: intersection
symbols.description: Elements belonging to both A and B.
symbols.description_zh: 同时属于 A 和 B 的元素构成的集合。

symbols.name: set difference
symbols.description: Elements of A that are not elements of B.
symbols.description_zh: 属于 A 但不属于 B 的元素。

symbols.name: symmetric difference
symbols.description: Elements in exactly one of A, B; equals (A∖B) ∪ (B∖A).
symbols.description_zh: 恰属于 A、B 中一个的元素，等于 (A∖B) ∪ (B∖A)。

symbols.name: power set
symbols.description: The set of all subsets of A, of cardinality 2 to the power card(A) for finite A.
symbols.description_zh: A 的所有子集构成的集合，有限时基数为 2 的 card(A) 次幂。

symbols.name: cartesian product
symbols.description: The set of all ordered pairs (a, b) with a ∈ A, b ∈ B.
symbols.description_zh: 所有有序对 (a, b)（a ∈ A，b ∈ B）的集合。

symbols.name: ordered pair
symbols.description: ⟨x, y⟩ has x as first coordinate and y as second; ⟨x,y⟩ = ⟨u,v⟩ iff x = u and y = v.
symbols.description_zh: ⟨x, y⟩ 以 x 为第一坐标、y 为第二坐标；两有序对相等当且仅当对应坐标相等。

symbols.name: cardinality
symbols.description: The number of elements of a finite set; generalised to cardinal numbers by bijections.
symbols.description_zh: 有限集合的元素个数；一般情形下用双射等价类定义基数。

symbols.name: aleph null
symbols.description: The cardinality of the natural numbers, the smallest infinite cardinal.
symbols.description_zh: 自然数集的基数，是最小的无限基数。

symbols.name: cardinality of the continuum
symbols.description: The cardinality of ℝ, equal to 2^ℵ₀.
symbols.description_zh: 实数集的基数，等于 2^ℵ₀。

symbols.name: complement
symbols.description: Relative to a fixed universe U, the elements of U not in A.
symbols.description_zh: 在固定全集 U 下，属于 U 而不属于 A 的元素。

symbols.name: binary relation on a set
symbols.description: A subset of A × A; (a,b) ∈ R is written a R b.
symbols.description_zh: A × A 的子集；(a,b) ∈ R 记作 a R b。

symbols.name: transitive closure
symbols.description: The smallest transitive relation containing R; equivalently ∪_{n≥1} Rⁿ.
symbols.description_zh: 包含 R 的最小传递关系，等价于 ∪_{n≥1} Rⁿ。

symbols.name: natural numbers
symbols.description: The counting numbers 0, 1, 2, … with addition, multiplication and order.
symbols.description_zh: 计数数集 0, 1, 2, …，带有加法、乘法与序结构。

symbols.name: integers
symbols.description: The ring of positive, zero and negative whole numbers.
symbols.description_zh: 正整数、零与负整数构成的环。

symbols.name: rational numbers
symbols.description: Fractions a/b with a, b ∈ ℤ and b ≠ 0; an ordered field.
symbols.description_zh: 形如 a/b（a, b ∈ ℤ，b ≠ 0）的数；是有序域。

symbols.name: real numbers
symbols.description: The complete ordered field, constructed from ℚ by Dedekind cuts or Cauchy sequences.
symbols.description_zh: 完备有序域，可由戴德金分割或柯西序列从 ℚ 构造。

symbols.name: complex numbers
symbols.description: Numbers a + bi with a, b ∈ ℝ; an algebraically closed field.
symbols.description_zh: 形如 a + bi（a, b ∈ ℝ）的数；是代数闭域。

symbols.name: quaternions
symbols.description: The non-commutative division algebra ℝ + ℝi + ℝj + ℝk with i² = j² = k² = ijk = −1.
symbols.description_zh: 非交换可除代数 ℝ + ℝi + ℝj + ℝk，满足 i² = j² = k² = ijk = −1。

symbols.name: prime field
symbols.description: The field ℤ/pℤ for a prime p; every finite field contains some 𝔽_p.
symbols.description_zh: p 为素数时的域 ℤ/pℤ；每个有限域都包含某个 𝔽_p。

symbols.name: divides
symbols.description: a ∣ b means there is an integer k with b = ak.
symbols.description_zh: a ∣ b 表示存在整数 k 使 b = ak。

symbols.name: congruence modulo n
symbols.description: a ≡ b (mod n) means n divides a − b; an equivalence relation on ℤ.
symbols.description_zh: a ≡ b (mod n) 表示 n 整除 a − b；是 ℤ 上的等价关系。

symbols.name: floor
symbols.description: The greatest integer not exceeding the real number x.
symbols.description_zh: 不超过实数 x 的最大整数。

symbols.name: ceiling
symbols.description: The least integer not smaller than the real number x.
symbols.description_zh: 不小于实数 x 的最小整数。

symbols.name: greatest common divisor
symbols.description: The largest positive integer dividing both a and b.
symbols.description_zh: 同时整除 a 与 b 的最大正整数。

symbols.name: least common multiple
symbols.description: The smallest positive integer divisible by both a and b.
symbols.description_zh: 同时被 a 与 b 整除的最小正整数。

symbols.name: p-adic valuation
symbols.description: The exponent of the prime p in the factorisation of n; a discrete valuation.
symbols.description_zh: n 的素因子分解中 p 的指数；是一个离散赋值。

symbols.name: irrational number
symbols.description: A real number that is not rational, e.g. √2 or π.
symbols.description_zh: 不是有理数的实数，例如 √2、π。

symbols.name: Euler's number
symbols.description: The base of the natural logarithm, e = lim(1+1/n)ⁿ = Σ 1/k! ≈ 2.71828.
symbols.description_zh: 自然对数的底，e = lim(1+1/n)ⁿ = Σ 1/k! ≈ 2.71828。

symbols.name: imaginary unit
symbols.description: The element i of ℂ with i² = −1.
symbols.description_zh: ℂ 中满足 i² = −1 的元素。

symbols.name: pi
symbols.description: Ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter, ≈ 3.14159; transcendental.
symbols.description_zh: 圆周长与直径之比，≈ 3.14159；是超越数。

symbols.name: square root
symbols.description: The non-negative y with y² = x, for x ≥ 0.
symbols.description_zh: 对 x ≥ 0，满足 y² = x 的非负 y。

symbols.name: real part
symbols.description: The real component x of a complex number z = x + iy.
symbols.description_zh: 复数 z = x + iy 的实部 x。

symbols.name: imaginary part
symbols.description: The real coefficient y in the decomposition z = x + iy.
symbols.description_zh: 分解 z = x + iy 中的实系数 y。

symbols.name: less than or equal
symbols.description: Partial order relation: x ≤ y iff x < y or x = y.
symbols.description_zh: 偏序关系：x ≤ y 当且仅当 x < y 或 x = y。

symbols.name: greater than or equal
symbols.description: The converse order relation: x ≥ y iff y ≤ x.
symbols.description_zh: 反向序关系：x ≥ y 当且仅当 y ≤ x。

symbols.name: not equal
symbols.description: x ≠ y abbreviates ¬(x = y); inequality of two objects.
symbols.description_zh: x ≠ y 是 ¬(x = y) 的缩写；表示两个对象不相等。

symbols.name: approximately equal
symbols.description: Used for numerical approximations or asymptotic closeness within a stated tolerance.
symbols.description_zh: 用于数值近似或在给定误差内的渐近接近。

symbols.name: definite integral
symbols.description: Integral of f over [a,b]: limit of Riemann sums, equal to signed area under the graph.
symbols.description_zh: f 在 [a,b] 上的积分：黎曼和的极限，等于图像下的有向面积。

symbols.name: indefinite integral (antiderivative)
symbols.description: A function F with F′ = f; determined up to an additive constant.
symbols.description_zh: 满足 F′ = f 的函数 F；相差一个可加常数。

symbols.name: contour integral
symbols.description: Integral of a complex function along a closed curve γ; basis of Cauchy theory and residues.
symbols.description_zh: 复函数沿闭曲线 γ 的积分；柯西理论与留数理论的基础。

symbols.name: Riemann–Stieltjes integral
symbols.description: Refines the Riemann integral by integrating against a monotonically increasing integrator α.
symbols.description_zh: 以单调递增的积分函数 α 对 f 积分，是黎曼积分的推广。

symbols.name: Lebesgue integral
symbols.description: Integral of a measurable function against a measure μ; extends the Riemann integral.
symbols.description_zh: 可测函数关于测度 μ 的积分；推广了黎曼积分。

symbols.name: summation
symbols.description: Sum of the terms a_1 + a_2 + … + a_n; generalises to arbitrary index sets.
symbols.description_zh: 各项之和 a_1 + a_2 + … + a_n；可推广到任意指标集。

symbols.name: product notation
symbols.description: Product a_1 · a_2 ⋯ a_n of finitely many factors.
symbols.description_zh: 有限多个因子的乘积 a_1 · a_2 ⋯ a_n。

symbols.name: limit
symbols.description: The value f(x) approaches as x approaches a; does not require f(a) to be defined.
symbols.description_zh: 当 x 趋于 a 时 f(x) 所趋近的值；不要求 f(a) 有定义。

symbols.name: limit superior
symbols.description: The infimum over n of sup_{k≥n} a_k; the largest subsequential limit.
symbols.description_zh: sup_{k≥n} a_k 关于 n 的下确界；最大的子列极限。

symbols.name: limit inferior
symbols.description: The supremum over n of inf_{k≥n} a_k; the smallest subsequential limit.
symbols.description_zh: inf_{k≥n} a_k 关于 n 的上确界；最小的子列极限。

symbols.name: n-th derivative
symbols.description: The n-fold derivative of f, defined recursively from f′ = df/dx.
symbols.description_zh: f 的 n 次导数，由 f′ = df/dx 递归定义。

symbols.name: partial derivative
symbols.description: Derivative of a multivariable function with respect to one variable, others held fixed.
symbols.description_zh: 多元函数对某一变量、其余变量固定时的导数。

symbols.name: gradient
symbols.description: The vector of all partial derivatives; points in the direction of steepest increase.
symbols.description_zh: 所有偏导数组成的向量，指向函数增长最快的方向。

symbols.name: Laplacian
symbols.description: The divergence of the gradient; Δf = Σ ∂²f/∂x_i² in Cartesian coordinates.
symbols.description_zh: 梯度的散度；笛卡尔坐标下 Δf = Σ ∂²f/∂x_i²。

symbols.name: epsilon–delta quantification
symbols.description: Prototypical form of an analysis limit or continuity statement: for every tolerance ε one can find a δ.
symbols.description_zh: 分析中极限与连续性的典型表述：对任意精度 ε 可找到 δ。

symbols.name: much less than
symbols.description: a is negligible relative to b: a/b → 0 in the relevant asymptotic regime.
symbols.description_zh: a 相对 b 可忽略：在相应渐近意义下 a/b → 0。

symbols.name: asymptotically equivalent (order)
symbols.description: a_n and b_n grow at the same rate, i.e. each is bounded by a constant multiple of the other.
symbols.description_zh: a_n 与 b_n 同阶增长，即各自被对方的常数倍控制。

symbols.name: big-O notation
symbols.description: f grows no faster than g: \lvert f\rvert ≤ C\lvert g\rvert eventually.
symbols.description_zh: f 的增长不快于 g：最终有 \lvert f\rvert ≤ C\lvert g\rvert。

symbols.name: little-o notation
symbols.description: f is negligible relative to g: f/g → 0.
symbols.description_zh: f 相对 g 可忽略：f/g → 0。

symbols.name: big-Theta notation
symbols.description: f and g have the same growth order: f = O(g) and g = O(f).
symbols.description_zh: f 与 g 同阶：f = O(g) 且 g = O(f)。

symbols.name: infinite series
symbols.description: The limit of the partial sums Σ_{n=0}^{N} a_n as N → ∞, when it exists.
symbols.description_zh: 部分和 Σ_{n=0}^{N} a_n 当 N → ∞ 时的极限（若存在）。

symbols.name: Taylor polynomial
symbols.description: The degree-n Taylor approximation of f around a; equals f when f is analytic at a.
symbols.description_zh: f 在 a 附近的 n 次泰勒近似；当 f 在 a 解析时等于 f。

symbols.name: norm
symbols.description: A non-negative length function on a vector space: ‖x‖=0 iff x=0, homogeneous, triangle inequality.
symbols.description_zh: 向量空间上的非负长度函数：正定、齐次、满足三角不等式。

symbols.name: supremum
symbols.description: The least upper bound of a non-empty set bounded above.
symbols.description_zh: 非空有上界集合的最小上界。

symbols.name: infimum
symbols.description: The greatest lower bound of a non-empty set bounded below.
symbols.description_zh: 非空有下界集合的最大下界。

symbols.name: uniform convergence
symbols.description: f_n → f uniformly if sup_x \lvert f_n(x) − f(x)\rvert → 0; stronger than pointwise convergence.
symbols.description_zh: 若 sup_x \lvert f_n(x) − f(x)\rvert → 0 则一致收敛；强于点态收敛。

symbols.name: distance in a metric space
symbols.description: A metric: positive definite, symmetric, and satisfying the triangle inequality.
symbols.description_zh: 满足正定、对称与三角不等式的度量。

symbols.name: infinity
symbols.description: The point at infinity in extended real arithmetic; indicates unbounded growth in limits and integrals.
symbols.description_zh: 扩展实数算术中的无穷远点；在极限与积分中表示无界增长。

symbols.name: convolution
symbols.description: (f∗g)(t) = ∫ f(τ) g(t−τ) dτ; the product making L¹ a Banach algebra.
symbols.description_zh: (f∗g)(t) = ∫ f(τ) g(t−τ) dτ；使 L¹ 成为巴拿赫代数的乘积。

symbols.name: epsilon and delta letters
symbols.description: Standard Greek letters for the tolerance ε and the response δ in limit and continuity proofs.
symbols.description_zh: 极限与连续性证明中表示精度 ε 与响应 δ 的标准希腊字母。

symbols.name: group operation
symbols.description: The associative binary operation of a group, with unit and inverses.
symbols.description_zh: 群的结合二元运算，带单位元与逆元。

symbols.name: identity element
symbols.description: The unique element e with e·g = g·e = g for every group element g.
symbols.description_zh: 对每个群元素 g 都有 e·g = g·e = g 的唯一元素 e。

symbols.name: inverse element
symbols.description: The element a⁻¹ with a·a⁻¹ = a⁻¹·a = e.
symbols.description_zh: 满足 a·a⁻¹ = a⁻¹·a = e 的元素 a⁻¹。

symbols.name: group
symbols.description: A set with an associative operation, an identity and inverses.
symbols.description_zh: 带结合运算、单位元与逆元的集合。

symbols.name: subgroup
symbols.description: A subset closed under the group operation, identity and inverses.
symbols.description_zh: 对群运算、单位元与逆元封闭的子集。

symbols.name: normal subgroup
symbols.description: A subgroup H with gHg⁻¹ = H for all g; equivalently a kernel.
symbols.description_zh: 满足对所有 g 有 gHg⁻¹ = H 的子群；等价于某个同态的核。

symbols.name: subgroup generated by S
symbols.name_zh: 由 S 生成的子群
symbols.description: The smallest subgroup containing the set S.
symbols.description_zh: 包含集合 S 的最小子群。

symbols.name: group isomorphism
symbols.description: A bijective group homomorphism; the groups are structurally identical.
symbols.description_zh: 双射的群同态；两群结构相同。

symbols.name: group homomorphism
symbols.description: A map preserving the group operation: φ(ab) = φ(a)φ(b).
symbols.description_zh: 保持群运算的映射：φ(ab) = φ(a)φ(b)。

symbols.name: kernel
symbols.description: The normal subgroup of elements mapped to the identity.
symbols.description_zh: 被映到单位元的元素构成的正规子群。

symbols.name: image
symbols.description: The subgroup of all values φ(g); G/ker φ ≅ im φ.
symbols.description_zh: 所有 φ(g) 构成的子群；G/ker φ ≅ im φ。

symbols.name: quotient group
symbols.description: The group of cosets of a normal subgroup N, with coset multiplication.
symbols.description_zh: 正规子群 N 的陪集构成的群，运算为陪集乘法。

symbols.name: direct product
symbols.description: Componentwise group structure on the Cartesian product of two groups.
symbols.description_zh: 两个群笛卡尔积上的逐分量群结构。

symbols.name: direct sum
symbols.description: The subgroup of the product of modules whose components vanish outside a finite set.
symbols.description_zh: 模的直积中只有有限多个分量非零的元素构成的子模。

symbols.name: tensor product
symbols.description: The universal R-bilinear map's target; linearises bilinear algebra.
symbols.description_zh: 万能 R-双线性映射的靶对象；把双线性代数线性化。

symbols.name: semidirect product
symbols.description: A group built from N and H with H acting on N by automorphisms.
symbols.description_zh: 由 N 与 H 构造、H 通过自同构作用于 N 的群。

symbols.name: cyclic group
symbols.description: A group generated by one element; isomorphic to ℤ or ℤ/nℤ.
symbols.description_zh: 由一个元素生成的群；同构于 ℤ 或 ℤ/nℤ。

symbols.name: symmetric group
symbols.description: The group of all permutations of an n-element set, of order n!.
symbols.description_zh: n 元集合上所有置换构成的群，阶为 n!。

symbols.name: alternating group
symbols.description: The kernel of the sign homomorphism: even permutations, of order n!/2 for n ≥ 2.
symbols.description_zh: 符号同态的核：偶置换组成的群，n ≥ 2 时阶为 n!/2。

symbols.name: dihedral group
symbols.description: The symmetry group of a regular n-gon, of order 2n.
symbols.description_zh: 正 n 边形的对称群，阶为 2n。

symbols.name: order of an element
symbols.description: The least positive k with g^k = e; divides the group order by Lagrange.
symbols.description_zh: 使 g^k = e 的最小正整数 k；由拉格朗日定理整除群的阶。

symbols.name: center of a group
symbols.description: The subgroup of elements commuting with every element of G.
symbols.description_zh: 与 G 中每个元素都交换的元素构成的子群。

symbols.name: commutator
symbols.description: The element g h g⁻¹ h⁻¹; trivial iff g and h commute.
symbols.description_zh: 元素 g h g⁻¹ h⁻¹；为 e 当且仅当 g 与 h 交换。

symbols.name: ideal
symbols.description: An additive subgroup of a ring closed under multiplication by ring elements.
symbols.description_zh: 对环元素乘法封闭的加法子群。

symbols.name: polynomial ring
symbols.description: Polynomials in one indeterminate over R, with formal addition and multiplication.
symbols.description_zh: 环 R 上一元多项式的集合，带形式加法与乘法。

symbols.name: finite field
symbols.description: A field with q = p^n elements; unique up to isomorphism for each prime power q.
symbols.description_zh: 含 q = p^n 个元素的域；对每个素数幂 q 在同构意义下唯一。

symbols.name: cycle notation
symbols.description: A permutation written as a product of disjoint cycles, composed right to left.
symbols.description_zh: 用互不相交轮换的乘积表示置换，按从右到左复合。

symbols.name: field extension degree
symbols.description: The dimension of K as a vector space over the subfield F.
symbols.description_zh: K 作为子域 F 上向量空间的维数。

symbols.name: ring homomorphism
symbols.description: A map preserving addition, multiplication and the multiplicative unit.
symbols.description_zh: 保持加法、乘法与乘法单位元的映射。

symbols.name: Galois group
symbols.description: The group of F-fixing field automorphisms of a Galois extension K/F.
symbols.description_zh: 伽罗瓦扩张 K/F 的保持 F 不动的域自同构群。

symbols.name: matrix
symbols.description: A rectangular array of scalars, with entrywise addition and matrix multiplication.
symbols.description_zh: 标量的矩形阵列，带逐元素加法与矩阵乘法。

symbols.name: determinant
symbols.description: The signed volume scaling of the linear map A; zero iff A is singular.
symbols.description_zh: 线性映射 A 的有向体积伸缩因子；A 奇异当且仅当它为零。

symbols.name: inverse matrix
symbols.description: The matrix B with AB = BA = I, existing iff det A ≠ 0.
symbols.description_zh: 满足 AB = BA = I 的矩阵 B，存在当且仅当 det A ≠ 0。

symbols.name: transpose
symbols.description: Reflection across the main diagonal: (Aᵀ)_{ij} = A_{ji}.
symbols.description_zh: 沿主对角线反射：(Aᵀ)_{ij} = A_{ji}。

symbols.name: trace
symbols.description: The sum of the diagonal entries; equals the sum of eigenvalues.
symbols.description_zh: 主对角线元素之和；等于特征值之和。

symbols.name: rank
symbols.description: The dimension of the column space; the number of nonzero singular values.
symbols.description_zh: 列空间的维数；非零奇异值的个数。

symbols.name: nullspace (kernel)
symbols.description: The subspace of vectors x with Ax = 0; dimension n − rank A.
symbols.description_zh: 满足 Ax = 0 的向量构成的子空间；维数为 n − rank A。

symbols.name: eigenvalue
symbols.description: A scalar λ for which Av = λv has a nonzero solution v.
symbols.description_zh: 使 Av = λv 有非零解 v 的标量 λ。

symbols.name: eigenvector
symbols.description: A nonzero vector v that the matrix only rescales: Av = λv.
symbols.description_zh: 矩阵只对其作伸缩的非零向量 v：Av = λv。

symbols.name: characteristic polynomial
symbols.description: det(λI − A); its roots are the eigenvalues with algebraic multiplicities.
symbols.description_zh: det(λI − A)；其根为各代数重数下的特征值。

symbols.name: inner product
symbols.description: A positive-definite symmetric bilinear form; measures length and angle.
symbols.description_zh: 正定对称双线性型；用于定义长度与夹角。

symbols.name: orthogonality
symbols.description: Two vectors are orthogonal when their inner product is zero.
symbols.description_zh: 内积为零的两向量互相正交。

symbols.name: orthogonal complement
symbols.description: The subspace of vectors orthogonal to every vector of A.
symbols.description_zh: 与 A 中每个向量都正交的向量构成的子空间。

symbols.name: projection (idempotent)
symbols.description: A linear map with P² = P; orthogonal projections are self-adjoint.
symbols.description_zh: 满足 P² = P 的线性映射；正交投影还是自伴的。

symbols.name: identity matrix
symbols.description: The diagonal matrix with 1s on the diagonal; neutral for multiplication.
symbols.description_zh: 主对角线全为 1 的矩阵；是矩阵乘法的单位元。

symbols.name: linear system
symbols.description: The system of linear equations encoded by matrix A and right-hand side b.
symbols.description_zh: 由矩阵 A 与右端 b 编码的线性方程组。

symbols.name: linear map
symbols.description: A map preserving vector addition and scalar multiplication.
symbols.description_zh: 保持向量加法与数乘的映射。

symbols.name: basis
symbols.description: A linearly independent spanning set; every vector is a unique finite combination.
symbols.description_zh: 线性无关的生成集；每个向量都有唯一的有限线性组合表示。

symbols.name: dimension
symbols.description: The cardinality of any basis of V.
symbols.description_zh: V 的任意一组基的基数。

symbols.name: dual space
symbols.description: The space of all linear functionals V → 𝕜.
symbols.description_zh: 全部线性泛函 V → 𝕜 构成的空间。

symbols.name: singular value decomposition
symbols.description: Factorisation of any matrix into orthogonal U, diagonal Σ ≥ 0 and orthogonal Vᵀ.
symbols.description_zh: 任意矩阵分解为正交 U、非负对角 Σ 与正交 Vᵀ 的乘积。

symbols.name: spectral radius
symbols.description: The maximum modulus of the eigenvalues of A; governs asymptotic growth of Aⁿ.
symbols.description_zh: A 的特征值的最大模；决定 Aⁿ 的渐近增长。

symbols.name: topology
symbols.description: A collection of open sets closed under arbitrary unions and finite intersections.
symbols.description_zh: 对任意并与有限交封闭的开集族。

symbols.name: open set
symbols.description: A member of the topology τ of a space X.
symbols.description_zh: 空间 X 的拓扑 τ 中的元素。

symbols.name: closed set
symbols.description: The complement of an open set; closed under finite unions and arbitrary intersections.
symbols.description_zh: 开集的补集；对有限并与任意交封闭。

symbols.name: interior
symbols.description: The union of all open sets contained in A.
symbols.description_zh: 包含于 A 的所有开集之并。

symbols.name: closure
symbols.description: The intersection of all closed sets containing A; adds all limit points.
symbols.description_zh: 包含 A 的所有闭集之交；加入全部极限点。

symbols.name: boundary of a set
symbols.description: cl(A) ∩ cl(X∖A); the points near both A and its complement.
symbols.description_zh: cl(A) ∩ cl(X∖A)；同时接近 A 与其补集的点。

symbols.name: dense subset
symbols.description: A is dense when its closure is the whole space.
symbols.description_zh: A 的闭包等于全空间时称为稠密。

symbols.name: connected space
symbols.description: A space that is not the union of two nonempty disjoint open sets.
symbols.description_zh: 不能表示为两个非空不交开集之并的空间。

symbols.name: relatively compact subset
symbols.description: K is relatively compact in U when its closure is compact and contained in U.
symbols.description_zh: K 的闭包紧且包含于 U 时称 K 在 U 中相对紧。

symbols.name: fundamental group
symbols.description: Homotopy classes of loops based at x₀, under concatenation.
symbols.description_zh: 以 x₀ 为基点的环路在同伦下的等价类，以衔接为运算。

symbols.name: singular homology
symbols.description: The homology of the singular chain complex; counts n-dimensional holes.
symbols.description_zh: 奇异链复形的同调；计数 n 维“洞”。

symbols.name: cohomology
symbols.description: The dual theory to homology, obtained from the cochain complex.
symbols.description_zh: 由上链复形得到的、同调的对偶理论。

symbols.name: boundary operator
symbols.description: The map C_n → C_{n−1} with ∂² = 0; defines chains, cycles and boundaries.
symbols.description_zh: 满足 ∂² = 0 的映射 C_n → C_{n−1}；定义链、闭链与边缘。

symbols.name: chain complex
symbols.description: A sequence of modules with boundary maps whose composition is zero.
symbols.description_zh: 带复合为零的边缘映射的模序列。

symbols.name: cup product
symbols.description: The ring product H^p × H^q → H^{p+q} making cohomology a graded ring.
symbols.description_zh: 使上同调成为分次环的乘积 H^p × H^q → H^{p+q}。

symbols.name: cap product
symbols.description: The action of cohomology on homology, H^p × H_n → H_{n−p}.
symbols.description_zh: 上同调对同调的作用 H^p × H_n → H_{n−p}。

symbols.name: wedge sum
symbols.description: The quotient of the disjoint union of pointed spaces identifying the base points.
symbols.description_zh: 把带基点空间的不交并中的基点粘合所得的商空间。

symbols.name: smash product
symbols.description: X × Y modulo the subspace (X × {y₀}) ∪ ({x₀} × Y).
symbols.description_zh: X × Y 模去子空间 (X × {y₀}) ∪ ({x₀} × Y)。

symbols.name: continuous map
symbols.description: A map for which preimages of open sets are open.
symbols.description_zh: 开集的原像仍为开集的映射。

symbols.name: homeomorphism
symbols.description: A continuous bijection with continuous inverse; the same topological shape.
symbols.description_zh: 具有连续逆的连续双射；拓扑形状相同。

symbols.name: homotopy equivalence
symbols.description: A map with a homotopy inverse; the spaces have the same homotopy type.
symbols.description_zh: 具有同伦逆的映射；两空间同伦型相同。

symbols.name: point
symbols.description: A primitive object of incidence geometry, located but without extent.
symbols.description_zh: 射影/关联几何中的基本对象，有位置而无大小。

symbols.name: line
symbols.description: A straight one-dimensional figure determined by two distinct points.
symbols.description_zh: 由两个不同点确定的直线。

symbols.name: line segment
symbols.description: The part of the line between points A and B, of length equal to the distance AB.
symbols.description_zh: 直线上 A、B 之间的部分，其长度等于两点之间的距离。

symbols.name: angle
symbols.description: The figure formed by rays BA and BC sharing vertex B.
symbols.description_zh: 以 B 为顶点、由射线 BA 与 BC 形成的图形。

symbols.name: triangle
symbols.description: Three non-collinear points with their three connecting segments.
symbols.description_zh: 三个不共线的点及其三条连线构成的图形。

symbols.name: parallel
symbols.description: Two coplanar lines that never meet; equal slopes.
symbols.description_zh: 同一平面内永不相交的两条直线；斜率相等。

symbols.name: perpendicular
symbols.description: Two lines meeting at a right angle (90°).
symbols.description_zh: 成直角（90°）相交的两条直线。

symbols.name: congruent
symbols.description: Figures related by an isometry; equal side lengths and angles.
symbols.description_zh: 存在等距变换使之一致的图形；边长与角分别相等。

symbols.name: similar
symbols.description: Figures with equal angles and proportional side lengths.
symbols.description_zh: 对应角相等、对应边成比例的图形。

symbols.name: circle
symbols.description: The locus of points at a fixed distance (radius) from a centre O.
symbols.description_zh: 到圆心 O 距离为定值（半径）的点的轨迹。

symbols.name: arc
symbols.description: A connected portion of a circle; measured by its central angle.
symbols.description_zh: 圆上的一段连通弧；用其所对圆心角度量。

symbols.name: geometric vector
symbols.description: A directed displacement with magnitude and direction.
symbols.description_zh: 带大小与方向的位移量。

symbols.name: dot product
symbols.description: u·v = ‖u‖‖v‖cos θ; measures projection and orthogonality.
symbols.description_zh: u·v = ‖u‖‖v‖cos θ；用于投影与正交判定。

symbols.name: cross product
symbols.description: The vector of length ‖u‖‖v‖sin θ normal to u and v, oriented by the right-hand rule.
symbols.description_zh: 长度 ‖u‖‖v‖sin θ、垂直于 u 与 v 的右手系向量。

symbols.name: curvature (plane curve)
symbols.description: κ = 1/R for a circle; measures how fast the tangent direction turns.
symbols.description_zh: 圆的曲率 κ = 1/R；度量切线方向转动的快慢。

symbols.name: spherical coordinates
symbols.description: Radius r, polar angle θ from the z-axis, azimuth φ in the xy-plane.
symbols.description_zh: 半径 r、与 z 轴的极角 θ、xy 平面内的方位角 φ。

symbols.name: angle measure
symbols.description: The size of an angle in degrees or radians.
symbols.description_zh: 以度或弧度表示的角的大小。

symbols.name: degree (angle unit)
symbols.description: 1/360 of a full turn; right angle = 90°, straight angle = 180°.
symbols.description_zh: 整个圆周的 1/360；直角为 90°，平角为 180°。

symbols.name: category
symbols.description: A class of objects with morphisms and associative composition, plus identities.
symbols.description_zh: 对象类、态射类、结合复合与单位态射构成的结构。

symbols.name: objects of a category
symbols.description: The collection of objects of a category 𝒞.
symbols.description_zh: 范畴 𝒞 的对象全体。

symbols.name: morphism
symbols.description: A map/arrow from object A to object B in a category.
symbols.description_zh: 范畴中从对象 A 到对象 B 的箭头。

symbols.name: hom-set
symbols.description: The set (or class) of all morphisms A → B in a category.
symbols.description_zh: 范畴中 A → B 的全部态射构成的集合或类。

symbols.name: composition of morphisms
symbols.description: The composite A → C obtained from f : A → B and g : B → C; associative.
symbols.description_zh: 由 f : A → B 与 g : B → C 得到的复合 A → C；满足结合律。

symbols.name: identity morphism
symbols.description: The morphism A → A that is neutral for composition.
symbols.description_zh: 复合运算的单位态射 A → A。

symbols.name: functor
symbols.description: A map on objects and morphisms preserving identities and composition.
symbols.description_zh: 保持恒等态射与复合的对象、态射映射。

symbols.name: natural transformation
symbols.description: A family of morphisms η_A : F(A) → G(A) making every naturality square commute.
symbols.description_zh: 满足所有自然性方块交换的态射族 η_A : F(A) → G(A)。

symbols.name: functor category
symbols.description: The category of functors 𝒞 → 𝒟 with natural transformations as morphisms.
symbols.description_zh: 以 𝒞 → 𝒟 的函子为对象、自然变换为态射的范畴。

symbols.name: set of natural transformations
symbols.description: The hom-set from F to G in the functor category.
symbols.description_zh: 函子范畴中从 F 到 G 的态射集。

symbols.name: adjunction
symbols.description: F is left adjoint to G when Hom(F(A), B) ≅ Hom(A, G(B)) naturally.
symbols.description_zh: 当 Hom(F(A), B) ≅ Hom(A, G(B)) 自然同构时，F 左伴随于 G。

symbols.name: limit (projective limit)
symbols.description: A universal cone over a diagram; generalises products, pullbacks and inverse limits.
symbols.description_zh: 图上的万能锥；推广乘积、拉回与逆向极限。

symbols.name: colimit (inductive limit)
symbols.description: A universal cocone under a diagram; generalises coproducts and pushouts.
symbols.description_zh: 图下的万能余锥；推广余积与推出。

symbols.name: pullback (fibre product)
symbols.description: The universal object completing a commutative square over a common codomain.
symbols.description_zh: 在共同靶对象上方补全交换方块的万能对象。

symbols.name: coproduct
symbols.description: The universal object receiving maps from every component; disjoint union in Set.
symbols.description_zh: 接收各分量映射的万能对象；在集合范畴中即不交并。

symbols.name: terminal object
symbols.description: An object with exactly one morphism from every object.
symbols.description_zh: 从任意对象恰有一个态射指向它的对象。

symbols.name: initial object
symbols.description: An object with exactly one morphism to every object.
symbols.description_zh: 指向任意对象恰有一个态射的对象。

symbols.name: monomorphism
symbols.description: A morphism cancellable on the left; generalises injective maps.
symbols.description_zh: 左可消去的态射；推广单射。

symbols.name: epimorphism
symbols.description: A morphism cancellable on the right; generalises surjective maps.
symbols.description_zh: 右可消去的态射；推广满射。

symbols.name: categorical isomorphism
symbols.description: A morphism with a two-sided inverse; an isomorphism in the arrow category sense.
symbols.description_zh: 具有双侧逆的态射。

symbols.name: equivalence of categories
symbols.description: A functor that is full, faithful and essentially surjective.
symbols.description_zh: 全、忠实且本质满的函子。

symbols.name: hom-functor
symbols.description: The functor 𝒞ᵒᵖ → Set sending A to Hom(A, X).
symbols.description_zh: 把 A 映到 Hom(A, X) 的函子 𝒞ᵒᵖ → Set。

symbols.name: Yoneda embedding
symbols.description: The fully faithful functor 𝒞 → Fun(𝒞ᵒᵖ, Set), A ↦ Hom(−, A).
symbols.description_zh: 全忠实函子 𝒞 → Fun(𝒞ᵒᵖ, Set)，A ↦ Hom(−, A)。

symbols.name: opposite category
symbols.description: The category with all arrows of 𝒞 reversed.
symbols.description_zh: 所有箭头方向反转所得的范畴。

symbols.name: groupoid
symbols.description: A category in which every morphism is invertible.
symbols.description_zh: 每个态射都可逆的范畴。

symbols.name: comma category
symbols.description: Objects are triples (A, f, B) with f : F(A) → G(B); morphisms are compatible pairs.
symbols.description_zh: 对象为三元组 (A, f, B)（f : F(A) → G(B)），态射为相容对。

symbols.name: monoidal category
symbols.description: A category with a tensor product, unit object and coherent associativity/unit constraints.
symbols.description_zh: 带张量积、单位对象以及相干结合、单位约束的范畴。

symbols.name: product in a category
symbols.description: The limit of a two-object discrete diagram; generalises cartesian product.
symbols.description_zh: 二元离散图的极限；推广笛卡尔积。

symbols.name: morphisms of a category
symbols.description: The collection of all morphisms of a category 𝒞, usually including every identity morphism.
symbols.description_zh: 范畴 𝒞 的全部态射构成的类，通常包含所有恒等态射。

symbols.name: probability
symbols.description: A number in [0,1] assigning likelihood to an event A, with P(Ω) = 1 and countable additivity.
symbols.description_zh: 把事件 A 的可能性赋为 [0,1] 中数值，满足 P(Ω)=1 与可列可加性。

symbols.name: conditional probability
symbols.description: P(A∣B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B), the probability of A given B (P(B) > 0).
symbols.description_zh: P(A∣B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B)，表示在 B 发生条件下 A 的概率。

symbols.name: expectation
symbols.description: The Lebesgue integral of X with respect to the probability measure: E[X] = ∫ X dP.
symbols.description_zh: 随机变量 X 关于概率测度的勒贝格积分：E[X] = ∫ X dP。

symbols.name: variance
symbols.description: E[(X − E[X])²] = E[X²] − (E[X])²; measures spread.
symbols.description_zh: E[(X − E[X])²] = E[X²] − (E[X])²；度量离散程度。

symbols.name: covariance
symbols.description: E[(X − E X)(Y − E Y)]; zero for independent variables.
symbols.description_zh: E[(X − E X)(Y − E Y)]；独立随机变量的协方差为零。

symbols.name: sigma-algebra
symbols.description: A family of subsets closed under complement and countable unions; the measurable events.
symbols.description_zh: 对补集与可列并封闭的子集族；即可测事件全体。

symbols.name: random variable
symbols.description: A measurable function from a probability space to the reals.
symbols.description_zh: 从概率空间到实数的可测函数。

symbols.name: normal distribution
symbols.description: The Gaussian law with mean μ and variance σ², density (2πσ²)^{-1/2} e^{-(x−μ)²/(2σ²)}.
symbols.description_zh: 均值为 μ、方差为 σ² 的高斯分布，密度为 (2πσ²)^{-1/2} e^{-(x−μ)²/(2σ²)}。

symbols.name: Bernoulli distribution
symbols.description: The law of a single success/failure trial with success probability p.
symbols.description_zh: 成功概率为 p 的单次成败试验的分布。

symbols.name: binomial distribution
symbols.description: The law of the number of successes in n independent trials with success probability p.
symbols.description_zh: n 次独立、成功率 p 的试验中成功次数的分布。

symbols.name: Poisson distribution
symbols.description: The law of counts with P(X=k) = e^{−λ}λᵏ/k!, mean and variance both λ.
symbols.description_zh: 计数分布，P(X=k) = e^{−λ}λᵏ/k!，均值与方差均为 λ。

symbols.name: exponential distribution
symbols.description: The law with density λe^{−λx} on x ≥ 0; models waiting times.
symbols.description_zh: 在 x ≥ 0 上密度为 λe^{−λx} 的分布；用于等待时间建模。

symbols.name: indicator function
symbols.description: The function equal to 1 on A and 0 elsewhere; E[1_A] = P(A).
symbols.description_zh: 在 A 上取 1、其余取 0 的函数；E[1_A] = P(A)。

symbols.name: independence
symbols.description: X and Y are independent when P(X∈A, Y∈B) = P(X∈A)P(Y∈B) for all measurable A, B.
symbols.description_zh: 对所有可测 A、B 有 P(X∈A, Y∈B) = P(X∈A)P(Y∈B)。

symbols.name: conditional independence
symbols.description: A and B are conditionally independent given C when P(A∩B∣C) = P(A∣C)P(B∣C).
symbols.description_zh: 当 P(A∩B∣C) = P(A∣C)P(B∣C) 时 A、B 在给定 C 下条件独立。

symbols.name: distributed as
symbols.description: X ∼ D means X has distribution D; here standard normal.
symbols.description_zh: X ∼ D 表示 X 服从分布 D；此处为标准正态分布。

symbols.name: almost surely
symbols.description: A property holds with probability 1.
symbols.description_zh: 性质以概率 1 成立。

symbols.name: probability density function
symbols.description: The Radon–Nikodym derivative of a continuous law with respect to Lebesgue measure.
symbols.description_zh: 连续分布关于勒贝格测度的拉东–尼科迪姆导数。

symbols.name: smooth manifold
symbols.description: A topological space locally homeomorphic to ℝⁿ with smoothly compatible charts.
symbols.description_zh: 局部同胚于 ℝⁿ 且坐标卡光滑相容的拓扑空间。

symbols.name: coordinate chart
symbols.description: A homeomorphism φ from an open set U of M onto an open set of ℝⁿ.
symbols.description_zh: 从 M 的开集 U 到 ℝⁿ 开集的同胚 φ。

symbols.name: tangent space
symbols.description: The vector space of tangent directions to M at the point p.
symbols.description_zh: 流形 M 在点 p 处切方向的向量空间。

symbols.name: cotangent space
symbols.description: The dual space of the tangent space; covectors act on tangent vectors.
symbols.description_zh: 切空间的对偶空间；余切向量作用于切向量。

symbols.name: space of k-forms
symbols.description: Smooth sections of ΛᵏT*M; k-forms can be integrated over k-dimensional domains.
symbols.description_zh: ΛᵏT*M 的光滑截面；k 形式可在 k 维区域上积分。

symbols.name: exterior derivative
symbols.description: The unique degree +1 derivation with d² = 0 extending the differential of functions.
symbols.description_zh: 满足 d² = 0、把函数微分推广到形式阶数加一阶的唯一导子。

symbols.name: exterior derivative on forms
symbols.description: Maps a k-form to a (k+1)-form; d(ω ∧ η) = dω ∧ η + (−1)ᵏω ∧ dη.
symbols.description_zh: 把 k 形式映为 k+1 形式；满足分次莱布尼茨律。

symbols.name: wedge product
symbols.description: The graded-commutative product of differential forms: ω∧η = (−1)^{pq}η∧ω.
symbols.description_zh: 微分形式的分次交换乘积：ω∧η = (−1)^{pq}η∧ω。

symbols.name: Lie bracket
symbols.description: The commutator of vector fields: [X,Y]f = X(Yf) − Y(Xf).
symbols.description_zh: 向量场的换位子：[X,Y]f = X(Yf) − Y(Xf)。

symbols.name: metric tensor
symbols.description: A smooth symmetric positive-definite 2-tensor defining lengths and angles on a manifold.
symbols.description_zh: 流形上的光滑对称正定二阶张量，定义长度与夹角。

symbols.name: Christoffel symbols
symbols.description: Connection coefficients Γᵏᵢⱼ = ½ g^{kl}(∂ᵢg_{jl} + ∂ⱼg_{il} − ∂ₗg_{ij}).
symbols.description_zh: 联络系数 Γᵏᵢⱼ = ½ g^{kl}(∂ᵢg_{jl} + ∂ⱼg_{il} − ∂ₗg_{ij})。

symbols.name: covariant derivative
symbols.description: Differentiates a vector field along another, using a connection.
symbols.description_zh: 沿另一向量场、借助联络对向量场求导。

symbols.name: Riemann curvature tensor
symbols.description: The curvature of the Levi-Civita connection; measures non-commutativity of covariant derivatives.
symbols.description_zh: 列维-奇维塔联络的曲率；度量协变导数的不交换性。

symbols.name: Ricci curvature
symbols.description: The trace of the Riemann tensor over the first and third indices.
symbols.description_zh: 黎曼张量对第一、第三指标求迹所得的张量。

symbols.name: scalar curvature
symbols.description: The full trace of the Ricci tensor; the simplest curvature invariant.
symbols.description_zh: 里奇张量的完全迹；最简单的曲率不变量。

symbols.name: pushforward
symbols.description: The derivative map sending tangent vectors of M to tangent vectors of N.
symbols.description_zh: 把 M 的切向量映到 N 的切向量的导数映射。

symbols.name: pullback of forms
symbols.description: The dual map on forms, (f*ω)(v) = ω(f*v).
symbols.description_zh: 形式上的对偶映射，(f*ω)(v) = ω(f*v)。

symbols.name: volume form
symbols.description: A nowhere-vanishing top-degree form; orients the manifold and defines integration.
symbols.description_zh: 处处非零的最高次形式；给出流形定向并定义积分。

symbols.name: Hodge star
symbols.description: Maps k-forms to (n−k)-forms using the metric and orientation; ⋆⋆ = ±1.
symbols.description_zh: 借助度量与定向把 k 形式映为 n−k 形式的算子；⋆⋆ = ±1。

symbols.name: geodesic
symbols.description: A curve whose acceleration is zero: ∇_{γ̇}γ̇ = 0; locally length-minimising.
symbols.description_zh: 加速度为零的曲线 ∇_{γ̇}γ̇ = 0；局部最短。

symbols.name: factorial
symbols.description: The product 1·2···n, counting orderings of n distinct objects; 0! = 1.
symbols.description_zh: 乘积 1·2···n，计数 n 个不同对象的全排列；约定 0! = 1。

symbols.name: binomial coefficient
symbols.description: The number of k-element subsets of an n-set; equals n!/(k!(n−k)!).
symbols.description_zh: n 元集合的 k 元子集个数；等于 n!/(k!(n−k)!)。

symbols.name: multinomial coefficient
symbols.description: The number of ordered partitions into parts of sizes k_i; n!/(k_1!⋯k_m!).
symbols.description_zh: 把 n 个对象分成大小 k_i 的有序组的数目；n!/(k_1!⋯k_m!)。

symbols.name: falling factorial
symbols.description: The product x(x−1)⋯(x−n+1), counting injections from an n-set.
symbols.description_zh: 乘积 x(x−1)⋯(x−n+1)，计数 n 元集合的单射数。

symbols.name: rising factorial
symbols.description: The product x(x+1)⋯(x+n−1), i.e. the Pochhammer symbol.
symbols.description_zh: 乘积 x(x+1)⋯(x+n−1)，即 Pochhammer 符号。

symbols.name: number of k-permutations
symbols.description: The number of injective maps from a k-set into an n-set.
symbols.description_zh: 从 k 元集到 n 元集的单射个数。

symbols.name: derangement number
symbols.description: The number of permutations of n objects with no fixed point.
symbols.description_zh: n 个对象无不动点的置换个数。

symbols.name: Catalan number
symbols.description: Counts Dyck paths, binary trees and balanced parentheses; C₀ = 1.
symbols.description_zh: 计数 Dyck 路径、二叉树与合法括号串；C₀ = 1。

symbols.name: Stirling number of the first kind
symbols.description: The number of permutations of n elements with exactly k cycles.
symbols.description_zh: n 元置换中恰含 k 个轮换的个数。

symbols.name: Stirling number of the second kind
symbols.description: The number of ways to partition an n-set into exactly k nonempty blocks.
symbols.description_zh: 把 n 元集合划分为 k 个非空块的方案数。

symbols.name: partition function
symbols.description: The number of ways to write n as a sum of nonincreasing positive integers.
symbols.description_zh: 把 n 写成单调递减正整数之和的方案数。

symbols.name: Bell number
symbols.description: The number of set partitions of an n-element set; B_n = Σ_k S(n,k).
symbols.description_zh: n 元集合的划分总数；B_n = Σ_k S(n,k)。

symbols.name: generating function
symbols.description: A formal power series encoding a sequence; algebraic operations mirror combinatorial ones.
symbols.description_zh: 编码序列的形式幂级数；代数运算对应组合运算。

symbols.name: inclusion–exclusion principle
symbols.description: Computes the size of a union by alternating sums of intersection sizes.
symbols.description_zh: 用交集大小的交错和计算并集大小。

symbols.name: Lean goal marker
symbols.description: In Lean's tactic state, `⊢ P` displays the current goal to be proved.
symbols.description_zh: Lean 策略状态中，`⊢ P` 显示当前待证目标 P。

symbols.name: anonymous function keyword
symbols.description: `fun x => e` defines the function mapping x to e; `fun x y => e` curries.
symbols.description_zh: `fun x => e` 定义把 x 映到 e 的函数；`fun x y => e` 表示柯里化。

symbols.name: universal binder in Lean
symbols.description: `∀ x, P x` and `∀ x : α, P x` are dependent function types for propositions.
symbols.description_zh: `∀ x, P x` 与 `∀ x : α, P x` 是命题意义下的依赖函数类型。

symbols.name: existential binder in Lean
symbols.description: `∃ x, P x` is `Exists (fun x => P x)`; proofs use `⟨witness, proof⟩`.
symbols.description_zh: `∃ x, P x` 即 `Exists (fun x => P x)`；证明形如 `⟨证据, 证明⟩`。

symbols.name: function type arrow
symbols.description: `A → B` is the type of functions from A to B; implications are functions on Prop.
symbols.description_zh: `A → B` 是从 A 到 B 的函数类型；命题蕴涵即 Prop 上的函数。

symbols.name: theorem declaration
symbols.description: `theorem name : statement := proof` declares a proof-checked theorem.
symbols.description_zh: `theorem name : statement := proof` 声明经内核检验的定理。

symbols.name: tactic block
symbols.description: `by` switches from term mode to tactic mode; tactics are commands separated by newlines.
symbols.description_zh: `by` 从项模式切换到策略模式；策略以换行分隔。

symbols.name: local assertion
symbols.description: `have h : P := proof` introduces an intermediate fact usable later.
symbols.description_zh: `have h : P := proof` 引入可后续使用的中间事实。

symbols.name: rewrite tactic
symbols.description: `rw [h]` rewrites the goal with the equation h, left to right.
symbols.description_zh: `rw [h]` 用等式 h 从左到右重写目标。

symbols.name: simplifier tactic
symbols.description: `simp` normalises the goal using the simp lemma set.
symbols.description_zh: `simp` 用 simp 引理集规范化目标。

symbols.name: exact tactic
symbols.description: `exact h` closes the goal with a term h whose type matches.
symbols.description_zh: `exact h` 用类型相符的项 h 直接关闭目标。

symbols.name: inductive type declaration
symbols.description: `inductive T where ∣ c : ...` declares constructors of an inductive type.
symbols.description_zh: `inductive T where ∣ c : ...` 声明归纳类型的构造子。

symbols.name: structure declaration
symbols.description: `structure S where field : Type` bundles named fields, generating projections.
symbols.description_zh: `structure S where field : Type` 打包带名域并生成投影函数。

symbols.name: typeclass declaration
symbols.description: `class C (α : Type) where op : ...` declares a typeclass; instances provide implementations.
symbols.description_zh: `class C (α : Type) where op : ...` 声明类型类；实例给出具体实现。

symbols.name: typeclass instance
symbols.description: `instance : C α := ...` registers an implementation for typeclass resolution.
symbols.description_zh: `instance : C α := ...` 注册供类型类解析使用的实现。

symbols.name: calculation block
symbols.description: `calc a = b := h₁ _ = c := h₂` chains equalities with justifications.
symbols.description_zh: `calc a = b := h₁ _ = c := h₂` 以理由逐行连接等式。

symbols.name: pattern matching
symbols.description: `match x with ∣ pat => e` performs structural case analysis on x.
symbols.description_zh: `match x with ∣ pat => e` 对 x 做结构性情形的分析。

symbols.name: do-notation
symbols.description: `do` blocks sequence monadic actions, e.g. `do let x ← m; pure (f x)`.
symbols.description_zh: `do` 块按单子顺序串接动作，例如 `do let x ← m; pure (f x)`。

symbols.name: lowercase Greek letters
symbols.description: Conventional names for types, coefficients, angles and ordinal variables in mathematics and Lean.
symbols.description_zh: 数学与 Lean 中表示类型、系数、角度与序数变量的惯用字母。

symbols.symbol: Γ Δ Θ Λ Ξ Π Σ Φ Ψ Ω
symbols.unicode: Γ Δ Θ Λ Ξ Π Σ Φ Ψ Ω
symbols.name: uppercase Greek letters
symbols.description: Conventional names for contexts, sums, products, groups and operators in mathematics and Lean.
symbols.description_zh: 数学与 Lean 中表示语境、和、积、群与算子的惯用字母。
